caption: The drawing depicts a long, formal dress in three views: a full-length, frontal view in the center, a right-side view in the top right, and a back view in the bottom right. The dress is predominantly a deep pinkish-red color with wide, dark blue horizontal bands along the sleeves and skirt. The bodice features a deep V-neck adorned with yellow trim and gray ruffles, with additional blue trim and ruffles framing the opening. The sleeves are long and feature blue and black cuffs edged with gray ruffles. The skirt is floor length, with three broad, horizontal blue bands spaced evenly down the length. The right-side view shows that the dress has a slight train, with the blue bands wrapping around the back and additional gray ruffle detailing. The back view reveals a bustle and a gathered section at the waist, also trimmed with blue and gray lace-like details. The dress appears to have a fitted waist, and the collar and cuffs are decorated with lace or ruffle detailing. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white.
